# Third-party dependencies

- `libdatachannel`: v0.24.5, MPL-2.0. Used for WebRTC ICE, DTLS-SRTP, and H.264
  RTP media transport. Its pinned official submodules provide libjuice,
  libSRTP, plog, usrsctp, and nlohmann/json. The SDK build disables upstream
  examples, tests, and WebSocket support.

See each dependency directory for its license text.
